newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnair says sells three DC-10 aircraft.
newsitem.headline: Finnair says sells three DC-10 aircraft.

text.p: Finnish national carrier Finnair Oy said on Friday it had sold three DC-10 aircrafts to Capra Corporation and would book a 40 million markka profit for the first plane in its report for the year to March 31, 1997.
"Finnair's board has approved the selling of three McDonnell Douglas DC-10-30 aircraft to Capra Corporation," Finnair said in a statement.
The first plane will be delivered to the buyer in February and the others will be delivered in April, it said.
Finnair said it will book the profits of the other two aircraft in the subsequent earnings reports but it did not say how big these profits would be.
